$comment: OpenStreetMap place types for local_supply (Part 11 design §3.2, D46). Read through @ct/publicdata (osmTags). A place type is listed only when every tag in it has an OSM wiki page and at least 10,000 uses on taginfo; `pnpm exec tsx tools/dev/osm-tags.ts check --write` checks each tag live (free; no Qloo) and writes verified_by, and an entry that fails is left out, never marked. groups: OR over groups, AND inside a group (eq, regex or exists). cuisine and sport values can be lists ("pizza;italian"), so their filters match one item of the list. group: tenant types are the storefronts mix:true counts (at most 22); specialty types are read only when asked. concepts: config/categories.json keys a type answers for; concept_notes say plainly when the count is broader than the concept. activity: shops plus food and drink places, the street-activity measure. metros: the counties each map city's city-level reference is counted over (their OSM admin_level=6 boundaries by Wikidata id, checked to resolve to exactly one boundary) and their land area from the Census 2020 Gazetteer (ALAND), so the city density divides the counties' counts by the counties' own land area. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
